comparison.objective: Exchange obstructed enclosure modules and close the enclosure; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR removes, collects, aligns, and installs multiple rail-guided modules around an obstruction. Candidate performs fine captive-fastener and collar manipulation followed by dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires correct replacement identities, seating, collection, lid retention, clearance, and stability; exact numeric thresholds are absent from the available body. Candidate requires two bounded stopping cycles and no drift or damage.
comparison.reason: Module exchange and enclosure closeout test multi-part extraction/insertion, not adjustment of damping response.
